name: Butterfly's Emissary
effect: Designated Target: designate a target to attack. Auto Attack: attacks enemies; marks the enemy's Weakspot on hit, making it take +25%/30%/35% extra Weakspot DMG for 5s.

buff.note: Markiert den Weakspot: +25/30/35% Weakspot DMG für 5 s.

name: Enchanting Void
effect: Midnight Maul: player transforms into a panther for 20s, auto-attacks and increases melee DMG taken by targets. Combat Assist: Movement Speed +10% with a melee weapon, recover 10% Max HP on melee hit.

buff.note: Midnight Maul: Nahkampf-DMG am Ziel +100% (nur Melee).

name: Lonewolf's Whisper
effect: Designated Target + Auto Attack: attacks enemies and attracts their aggro; spawns a clone when a target dies. Increases Weapon DMG received by the attacked target by 21.6% (Lunar version: +5% Weapon DMG, +10% at low Sanity).

buff.note: Erhöht den Weapon DMG, den das angegriffene Ziel erhält (theriagames, Werte je Stufe). Varianten (Lunar Oracle, Radiant) nennen 18.75/25/31.25/37.5/43.75%.

name: Mini Feaster
effect: Touch of the Abyss: follows the player, summons tentacles near enemies to smash. When a target triggers Bounce, tentacles are guaranteed next to it and enhance the player's Weapon DMG.

buff.note: +17% Weapon DMG je Tentakel, max. 70% (bei Bounce-Builds praktisch dauerhaft).

name: Mr. Wish
effect: Rapid Fire: bursts at enemies near the crosshair, marking them with The Bull's Eye. Auto Attack.

buff.note: Markiert Ziele mit The Bull's Eye; +8% DMG gegen markierte Ziele für 12 s (eine Quelle nennt zusätzlich Weakspot DMG +30% gegen markierte Ziele; ggf. manuell eintragen).

name: Polar Jelly
effect: Frostlash: knocks back enemies and forms a fortification. Auto Attack: continuously deals Frost Status DMG to surrounding enemies and pulls them toward it; increases Frost DMG received by 36%. Frost Vortexes formed inside its radius create additional Ice Spikes.

name: Pyro Dino
effect: Designated Target + Autonomous Attack: attacks enemies, increases Blaze DMG received by 24.5%. Attacking a target affected by Burn causes an Explosion.

buff.note: Ziel erhält +24.5% Blaze DMG; Explosion auf brennende Ziele.

name: Snowsprite
effect: Auto Attack: generates Ice Crystals near the target every 3s. Crystals shatter when shot, dealing 37.5% to 87.5% Frost DMG to nearby targets and making them take +18% to +42% Frost DMG.

buff.note: Frostkristalle erhöhen den erhaltenen Frost DMG (Wert geschätzt).

name: ZapCam
